svg.title: Avalanche rescuer — Woman
svg.desc: A fictional woman working as avalanche rescuer, wearing a rescue jacket and a rescue helmet. Visible work cue: A marked avalanche probe is paired with a compact search transceiver above a snow-slope profile. The person is on the right, with the work cue on the left. Occupational headgear: a rescue helmet.
